title: Differentiable nullspace active-face Newton projection for hard-constrained neural optimization
coding_guidance: Edit only model.py; never modify eval.py/data.py/task_spec.json. Preserve solve(problem,config) returning a finite vector y satisfying M@y=b and lower<=y<=upper while minimizing 0.5*y.T@Q@y + q.T@y + alpha*sum(sin(y)). Never access hidden reference values. CRITICAL DESIGN REQUIREMENTS: (1) Combine algebraic nullspace reparameterization y = y_p + V w via rank-revealing orthonormal QR/SVD (enforcing ||M y - b||_inf ~ 1e-15 by construction) with reduced active-face second-order Newton steps using exact Hessian H(y) = Q - alpha*diag(sin(y)) and cached face tangent basis Z. (2) Keep the core solver streamlined without redundant unexercised branches; expose clean orthogonal boolean config toggles: nullspace_reduction (default True), exact_hessian (default True), active_face_caching (default True), row_equilibration (default False), armijo_line_search (default True) so all 5 Stage-4 ablations cleanly isolate each mechanism's contribution without dead flags. Always return a finite iterate y when an ablation toggle is disabled.
metric_description: Composite projection error mse = rs_mean + 50*cv_max + 0.05*solve_time_ms with minimized primal-dual KKT certificate, cached-DR & tuned OSQP/ADMM baselines, implicit differentiation backward pass & end-to-end neural layer training, and d<=128 degeneracy stress sweep.
